title: Optical Coherence Tomography Predictors of Favorable Functional Response in Naïve Diabetic Macular Edema Eyes Treated with Dexamethasone Implants as a First-Line Agent

groups.description: Treatment-naive centre-involving DME with central macular thickness of at least 300 um, retrospective (University of Messina), 39 eyes of 39 patients: one dexamethasone implant at baseline as first-line treatment; a second implant was given at 6 months in 5 eyes.

exclusions.what: Proportion of patients with more than 10 letters of improvement (Results text)
Logistic regression of OCT predictors of a favourable functional response
exclusions.reason: model estimates and groups defined by post-baseline response are not admissible

exclusions.what: Table 2 rows other than BCVA (CMT, SRD, HRS, cysts, choroidal thickness, DRIL, EZ, vitreomacular interface)

notes: Unit: ETDRS letters (Table 2 row label; BCVA measured with the ETDRS chart, Methods).
Regimen single: one implant per eye in the reported period, with a second implant at 6 months in 5 eyes (re-implants not removed).
Role control: marketed implant, single-arm cohort.
Lens status (phakic or pseudophakic) is given in Table 1; no change in lens status was observed (Results).
Central macular thickness and other OCT biomarkers (Table 2) are reported in the article and mentioned here only.

series.baseline_label: Baseline (Table 2, row R2 'BCVA ETDRS letters', column C2)
series.notes: Table 2, its footnote and the Methods do not label the statistic; the Results text reports these same cells as the mean BCVA in ETDRS letters at baseline and 3, 6 and 12 months, so they are read as means. The Abstract prints different dispersion values for baseline and 12 months (text against table: the table cells are cited). Times after the implant. Per-visit n not reported; no minimum follow-up criterion stated. A second implant at 6 months in 5 eyes; values were not stated as removed or replaced, so all visits are kept. Handling of missing visits not stated.
